summary: Russia conducted a massive strike on Kyiv targeting industrial facilities and residential buildings, resulting in three civilian deaths. Ukraine reported the downing of two Russian aircraft, identified as a Su-34 and a Su-35. US President Trump announced plans to grant Ukraine licenses to produce Patriot missiles and intends to call Vladimir Putin.
key_points: Russia launched a massive strike on Kyiv, hitting the Samsung Ukraine plant and causing secondary detonations in Vyshnevoye (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/31461, @ukr_leaks_eng/31462).
Three civilians were killed in Kyiv following UAV attacks throughout the day (Source: @eRadarrua/100377).
Ukraine's Air Force shot down two Russian aircraft, identified as a Su-34 and a Su-35 (Source: @UkraineNow/82508, @kpszsu/67758).
President Trump stated the US will provide Ukraine with a license to produce Patriot systems (Source: @tass_agency/384348).
Ukraine has rejected Trump's 28-point peace plan, which required withdrawal from Donbass, seeking more favorable terms (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/31470).
Norway is allocating nearly €300 million (3 billion kroner) for Ukraine's air defense via the PURL program (Source: @UkraineNow/82495).
Russian forces in the Volchansk direction reportedly advanced up to 800 meters across twelve sectors (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/31467).

sections.executive_summary: Russia conducted a massive strike on Kyiv targeting the Samsung Ukraine plant and residential areas, resulting in three deaths. Ukraine reported the downing of a Su-34 and a Su-35 aircraft. Diplomatic tensions persist as Ukraine rejects a 28-point peace plan while the US proposes Patriot production licenses.

points: Ukraine rejected a 28-point peace plan presented in November, which required the withdrawal of Ukrainian troops from Donbass (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/31470).
President Zelensky stated he cannot travel to Moscow for negotiations due to danger from Ukrainian drones (Source: @UkraineNow/82510).
The Ukrainian Air Force confirmed the downing of a Russian Su-35 multi-purpose fighter on July 8, 2026 (Source: @kpszsu/67758).
Monitoring channels report the downing of a Su-34 fighter-bomber used for dropping KAB bombs (Source: @UkraineNow/82508).
Ukraine is receiving nearly €300 million from Norway for air defense, with some missiles being sourced from countries with existing stock for faster delivery (Source: @UkraineNow/82495).
Russian forces struck the Samsung Ukraine plant in Kyiv, where FP-5 Flamingo cruise missile components were reportedly manufactured and stored (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/31461).
Russian forces in the Kupyansk area are reportedly expanding their zones of control within urban areas (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/31467).
Russian forces in the Dobropolye direction are intensifying pressure on the approaches to the city, with fighting ongoing for Sergeyevka (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/31467).
Russian forces in the Slavyansk direction are reportedly leveling the front for an advance toward Nikolayevka (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/31467).
Russian forces in the Dnepropetrovsk region reportedly occupied strongholds in the area of Alexandrovka and Bogodarovka (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/31467).
In the Volchansk direction, Russian forces reportedly advanced up to 800 meters in twelve sectors (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/31467).
Small-arms battles are ongoing in the village of Yurchenkovo, the settlement of Bely Kolodez, and forest areas of the Volchansk district (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/31467).
Fighting is reported in the village of Petro-Ivanovka and forest areas near Shevyakovka, Budarki, and Zemlyanki on the Velikoburluk direction (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/31467).
Russian forces are reportedly expanding control in urban areas of Kupyansk (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/31467).
Fighting is ongoing in villages on the approach to Kramatorsk south of the Slavyansk direction (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/31467).
In the Shostka district (Sumy direction), assault troops of AG 'North' are engaged in small-arms battles in Bachevsk and the area of Ulanovo (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/31467).
Small-arms battles continue in Ryzhevka, Pisarevka, Marino, Novaya Sich, Khoten, and forest areas south of Ivolzhanskoye in the Sumy district (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/31467).
AG 'North' reports continuing offensive operations in the settlement of Kazachya Lopan on the Kharkov direction (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/31467).
In the Belgorod region, a Ukrainian FPV drone detonated near a bus in Tavrovo, injuring two civilians (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/31467).
AFU forces have reportedly destroyed bridges in the border villages of Shelayevo and Urazovo (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/31467).
Units of AG 'East' reportedly captured strongholds west of Lesnoye in the eastern part of the Zaporozhye region (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/31467).
Artillery shelling in the Kamensko-Dneprovsky district of Dneprorudnoye damaged gas supply lines (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/31467).
In the Kherson region, mortar shelling in Cossack Camps of the Aleshkinsky Municipal District injured a woman and a man (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/31467).
Infrastructure strikes in numerous Kherson region villages have caused power supply problems (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/31467).
A massive strike on Kyiv hit the Desnyansky district, where a UAV hit a three-story non-residential building near a market (Source: @UkraineNow/82504).
A UAV strike in the Desnyansky district of Kyiv hit a high-rise building, resulting in the evacuation of an injured child (Source: @UkraineNow/82513).
Jet UAVs were tracked moving toward Pyryatyn from the south in Poltava region and toward Auly/Kamyanske from the south in Dnipropetrovsk region (Source: @kpszsu/67771, @eRadarrua/100379).
Jet UAVs were reported over the border of Nikopol district (Dnipropetrovsk) and Zaporozhye region, moving north/north-west (Source: @kpszsu/67772).
A UAV from the Black Sea was tracked moving toward the Odesa region (Zatoka/Karolino-Bugaz) (Source: @kpszsu/67772).
Ukrainian forces shot down a Su-35 multi-purpose fighter and a Su-34 fighter-bomber (Source: @kpszsu/67758, @UkraineNow/82508).

key_developments: Russia conducted a massive strike on Kyiv, hitting the Samsung Ukraine plant and residential buildings, killing three people (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/31461, @eRadarrua/100377).
Ukraine shot down two Russian aircraft, a Su-34 and a Su-35, on July 8, 2026 (Source: @UkraineNow/82508, @kpszsu/67758).
President Trump announced the US will grant Ukraine a license to produce Patriot missiles (Source: @tass_agency/384348).
Ukraine rejected Trump's 28-point peace plan, citing a change in the battlefield situation (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/31470).
Norway is providing €268 million via the PURL program to purchase US air defense weapons for Ukraine (Source: @UkraineNow/82495).
Russian forces reportedly advanced 800 meters in twelve sectors in the Volchansk direction (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/31467).
President Trump claimed the US received a share of Ukrainian land following agreements on minerals (Source: @tass_agency/384363).
sections.threat_assessment: The use of jet UAVs across multiple regions (Kyiv, Poltava, Dnipropetrovsk, Zaporozhye) indicates an expanded aerial threat profile. The strike on the Samsung Ukraine plant suggests a targeting strategy focused on missile component production. The reported Russian advances in Volchansk and Kupyansk indicate continued pressure on the eastern front.
sections.regional_response: Norway is accelerating air defense deliveries by purchasing from countries with existing stock to bypass long delivery times. Ukraine is seeking more favorable peace terms, rejecting the Donbass withdrawal requirement. The US is shifting toward supporting domestic Ukrainian production of high-end systems like the Patriot.
sections.intelligence_notes: Valeriy Zaluzhny suggests a state of 'equilibrium' on the battlefield, arguing that the war's outcome depends on societal endurance rather than tactical successes. Reports of Ukrainian intelligence involvement in a bombing in Europe (Anastasia Berezovskaya) may complicate Western support efforts. Polish military aid is reported at $4.4 billion from March 2022 to June 2026 (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/31453).
